INSERT INTO task_cards (column_id, project_id, title, description, priority, position, labels, checklist, estimate)
               VALUES ($1, $5, $2, $3, $4,
                       COALESCE((SELECT MAX(position) + 1 FROM task_cards WHERE column_id = $1), 0),
                       NULLIF($6, ''), NULLIF($7, ''), $8)
               RETURNING id AS "id: i64"
